correctness.rationale: Complete face classification for arbitrary Latin squares; the nerve of 3n line simplices plus all rainbow triangles is the full three-factor discrete join, hence simply connected. Unique free rainbow facets collapse all intercalate tetrahedra leaving a 2D CW model. Euler characteristic gives (n-1)^3-I(M) spheres via integral Hurewicz and Whitehead. Exact independent maximal clique and chain computations tested n=2 through 6 and distinct isotope types. No computation is relied on for infinite quantifiers.
